jobs.title: Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Ninety One is a global investment management firm committed to delivering innovative financial solutions and sustainable growth for its clients. Established with a vision to redefine investment standards, Ninety One combines extensive industry expertise with a forward-thinking approach to asset management. With a presence in key financial markets across the world, the company prides itself on its client-centric philosophy, integrity, and commitment to excellence. Ninety One's diverse portfolio spans equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternative investments, catering to a broad spectrum of institutional and individual investors. The organization fosters a dynamic and inclusive workplace culture that encourages professional development, collaboration, and innovation.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Investment Analyst to join our team at Ninety One. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work closely with senior investment professionals, contribute to the development of investment strategies, and support the management of client portfolios. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting in-depth market research, analyzing financial data, and assisting in the evaluation of investment opportunities across various asset classes. The role requires a proactive approach, strong analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly. As part of our team, you will play a vital role in supporting Ninety One’s mission to deliver superior investment performance and innovative solutions to our clients worldwide.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant professional certifications such as CFA or CPA are advantageous. Candidates should have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience in investment analysis, asset management, or related financial services. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, proficiency in financial modeling, and familiarity with investment research tools and software are essential. Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively both independently and within a team are crucial for success in this role. A demonstrated passion for financial markets and a commitment to continuous learning will set candidates apart.

Responsibilities

Conduct comprehensive market and industry research to identify emerging trends and investment opportunities.

Analyze financial statements, economic data, and market conditions to evaluate the potential risks and returns of various investment options.

Develop and maintain detailed financial models to support investment decision-making processes.

Assist in the preparation of investment reports, presentations, and recommendations for internal and external stakeholders.

Monitor and review existing investment portfolios to ensure alignment with client objectives and market developments.

Collaborate with senior team members to develop and refine investment strategies based on research findings and market insights.

Participate in client meetings and discussions, providing insights and updates on portfolio performance and market outlooks.

Stay updated on regulatory changes, economic developments, and industry best practices to ensure compliance and maintain a competitive edge.

Benefits

Ninety One offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance coverage, retirement plans, and wellness programs. Employees have access to ongoing training and development opportunities, including industry certifications, workshops, and seminars to enhance their skills. The company promotes a healthy work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and encourages a collaborative and inclusive environment. Additionally, Ninety One values diversity and inclusion, fostering a workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to the organization’s success.

Equal Opportunity

Ninety One is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to serve our clients effectively and drives innovation within our organization. All qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to any protected status, and we are dedicated to providing a work environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Book and Periodical Publishing
